messages:
Samira Patel: Heads up, we need to coordinate a short maintenance window for the base-image rebuild + keystore bridge changes. goal: ensure image signer can rotate to the new KMS key and audit logs capture key usage. thinking Friday 10:00-10:30 PT.
Kai Nguyen: +1. does this include the attestation fallback we discussed?
Samira Patel: Yes — plan is: 1) rotate signer key -> new KMS alias, 2) update signer service account RBAC, 3) run a canary rebuild and verify signatures + logs, 4) exercise attestation fallback to software signer.
Linh Tran: Need exact RBAC change. who will apply the clusterrolebinding? we should minimize blast radius.
Kai Nguyen: I can propose the least-privilege binding. suggestion: dedicated serviceAccount `image-signer@infra` with a scoped IAM role that only calls KMS:Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign/Verify on the single key. kubectl snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: image-signer-kms
  namespace: infra-signer
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
and then the IAM trust policy for the node/pod identity. keep it tight.
Samira Patel: good. also need to add an audit policy rule so that KMS key usage is forwarded to central audit for 1 year. Linh, can you confirm our audit pipeline can store key-granular events?
Linh Tran: We can. need to add a mapping from KMS envelope events to the syslog stream: add a filter in log-forwarder. retention already at 365d for keystore events, but we'll tag with `rebuild_run_id`. small change.
sec-bot: Automated check: existing signer SA has cluster-admin bindings -> FAIL. See https://ci.redwood/inventory/roles/infra-signer for details. :warning:
Kai Nguyen: ugh that cluster-admin binding is ancient. we should remove it before rotation. Proposed removal steps: 1) create new scoped Role & RoleBinding, 2) create time-limited canary binding for 24h, 3) revoke old binding.
ops-oncall: From an oncall perspective, make sure the rollback path doesn't depend on the new KMS key. If rotation fails, we need an immediate fallback that uses the staging key + queued rebuilds should be paused. can we add a kill-switch?
Samira Patel: yes — we'll add a `rebuild/disable` feature flag in the pipeline. ops-oncall, can you own the kill-switch and the rollback playbook?
ops-oncall: I got it. will prepare runbook section and quick commands. e.g. ```bash
# pause rebuild pipeline
curl -X POST $PIPELINE_API/flags/rebuild_disable -d '{"reason":"kms-rotation"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
Ava (intern): quick question — how do we verify audit logs actually include the signature key id during the canary? any sample query?
Linh Tran: Query example (ELK): ```json
{"query": {"bool": {"must": [{"match": {"event.type": "kms.key_usage"}}, {"match": {"resource.key_id": "projects/…/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/ck"}}]}}}
```
Samira Patel: Action items: Kai -> prepare RBAC YAML + IAM policy diff by Thu EOD. Linh -> update log-forwarder filter and add `rebuild_run_id` tag. ops-oncall -> draft rollback and owner the kill-switch. Ava -> run the canary and validate logs, I'll pair with you.
Kai Nguyen: I'll also include a pre-flight lint job that checks for any cluster-admin bindings for the signer SA (fail the deploy if present).
sec-bot: Scheduled scan queued: will re-run RBAC inventory after changes and post results.
Samira Patel: final note — we should run the canary against a non-prod registry, and sign two images: one with new KMS signer and one with local software signer to exercise fallback. keep the window short.
ops-oncall: I'll be on-call for the window and watching alerts. please ping #eng-oncall when we start.
Samira Patel: Thanks all — planning doc updated: https://wiki.redwood/internal/keystore-bridge-rebuild (please add comments).
